preregistration.provenance_note: PREREG Sec 0: structural/coverage facts only seen pre-freeze; no event-window price, implied probability, at-risk identity, or price-vs-outcome pairing computed; occurrence-time data excluded by the leakage rule

config.station_cohort: NYC only (KXHIGHNY tmax_f, KXLOWTNYC tmin_f); CHI/DEN/LAX excluded for zero candle coverage -- Sec 2
config.unit: variable-day; adjacent at-risk contract (primary) + adjacent locked-NO contract (control)
config.event_time: archived publication timestamp of the day's first CLI product (naive-UTC) -- Sec 3
config.windows: PRE [E-90m, E-10m]; POST [E+15m, E+120m]; placebo P = E-240m, same shapes -- Sec 3
config.price: bid/ask midpoint of last fully-quoted candle in-window (Decimal cents/100); trade-price is sensitivity only
config.strike_semantics: between: floor<=v<=cap; greater: v>floor; less: v<cap -- Sec 4, validated by G3
config.at_risk: YES region entirely beyond the preliminary in the physically possible direction; adjacent = nearest such region -- Sec 4
config.primary_estimand: D = mean(p_POST - y) over the primary cohort; D<0 = underpriced revision risk
config.ci_method: D +/- z*s/sqrt(N), z = 1.959963984540054, deterministic; Decimal precision-50; 1e-12 quantized decisions
config.decision_rule: 0 gate fails -> BLOCKED; 1 L(D)>0 -> OVERPRICED; 2 U(D)<0 -> UNDERPRICED; 3 CI within (-0.075,+0.075) -> EFFICIENT-WITHIN-MARGIN; 4 else INCONCLUSIVE -- Sec 6
config.multiplicity: one primary cell, pooled variables; everything else non-decisional -- Sec 5

eligibility_gates._note: Order G1a -> G1b -> G2 -> G3 -> G4; sentinel 'not_evaluated' after first failure.

descriptive_results.locked_no_control: <TO_BE_FILLED: mean post-event price of certain-NO contracts>

reproducibility_verification.serialization_policy: Every non-integer decision-relevant quantity is a JSON string: Decimal quantized to 1e-12 via ROUND_HALF_EVEN, fixed-point, 12 digits. Integer counts remain plain JSON integers.
